channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: deary lean into their devotion to shoegaze with seven-and-a-half minute single “Alfie”
item.description: Ahead of their their debut album Birding, South London trio deary craft a tender dreampop number with crystallized emotion.

item.title: Bel Cobain announces new EP, Kizzy
item.description: East London singer Bel Cobain has announced her upcoming EP, Kizzy, and shared new single, "Fucking City".

item.title: Juni Habel and the slow, deliberate bloom of becoming
item.description: Juni Habel tells BEST FIT why embracing both playfulness and patience was key to making Evergreen in Your Mind, her third album out in April.

item.title: Squarepusher announces new album, Kammerkonzert
item.description: Squarepusher, the project of electronic musician Tom Jenkinson, has announced his upcoming album Kammerkonzert and shared new single "K2 Central".

item.title: Jarvis Cocker, Beth Orton, Rufus Wainwright and Anna Calvi lead Barbican tribute to Marianne Faithfull
item.description: Jarvis Cocker, Beth Orton, Anna Calvi and Rufus Wainwright will gather at the Barbican next month to celebrate the life and work of Marianne Faithfull, paired with a screening of the new documentary Broken English.

item.title: Guided By Voices announce their 44th album Crawlspace Of The Pantheon
item.description: Barely a season passes without news of another Guided by Voices record and spring is bringing us Crawlspace Of The Pantheon, their 44th.

item.title: Bill Callahan gets unsentimental on My Days of 58
item.description: My Days of 58's instrumentation sounds unscripted, largely improvised, and in this way, it captures Bill Callahan at his most unguarded and unrehearsed.

item.title: Gorillaz find beauty and joy amidst loss on the mesmerising The Mountain
item.description: The most substantial and satisfying Gorillaz album in ten years, The Mountain feels deeper and more emotionally resonant than any of its predecessors.

item.title: tofusmell announces debut album All My Time, shares new single “Dreams I’ve Had”
item.description: Winnipeg-based DIY musician Rae Chen, who records as tofusmell, has detailed his first full-length record All My Time, set for release this April.

item.title: Ca$ino is Baby Keem's statement of intent
item.description: On Ca$ino, Baby Keem offers a rare experience in the modern hip-hop landscape, a cohesive album with emotional depth, lyrical weight and sonic variety – delivered by a rapper born this century.
